title: A fundamental plane of black hole accretion at millimetre wavelengths
question: Whether a tight correlation (fundamental plane) exists at millimetre wavelengths between nuclear 1 mm luminosity, intrinsic 2-10 keV X-ray luminosity, and supermassive black hole mass across low- and high-luminosity AGN, and what physical accretion/ejection mechanism drives it.

data.angular_resolution: 0.042 to 0.723 arcsec (6 to 330 pc, average spatial resolution ~25 pc)

what.value: Intrinsic 2-10 keV X-ray luminosities of primary sample sources

evidence.quote: The intrinsic (absorption-corrected) 2–10 keV luminosities ( 𝐿 X , 2−10 ) of the primary sample sources were retrieved from the literature, as detailed in Elford et al. (2023).

what.value: Accurate intrinsic nuclear 2-10 keV X-ray luminosities for 26/33 Chandra-observed primary sample objects

evidence.quote: For most of the Chandra -observed objects (26/33), accurate (intrinsic) nuclear 𝐿 X , 2−10 were retrieved from the catalogue of Bi et al. (2020, see also Table A1).

what.value: MBH-sigma_* relation and stellar velocity dispersion compilation

evidence.quote: For the remaining 17 galaxies, we estimated 𝑀 BH using the 𝑀 BH – 𝜎 ★ relation of van den Bosch (2016), where 𝜎 ★ is the stellar velocity dispersion within one effective radius.
This was retrieved from the compilations of van den Bosch (2016) and Cappellari et al. (2013) when available, from the HyperLeda database otherwise ( http://leda.univ-lyon1.fr ).

what.value: ALMA 1 mm observations and nuclear intrinsic 2-10 keV X-ray luminosities for 88 BASS galaxies

evidence.quote: We included only the BASS sources for which both ALMA 1 mm observations (with spatial resolutions similar to those of the primary sample) and nuclear intrinsic 𝐿 X , 2−10 were available (88 sources; Kawamuro et al. 2022).
The SMBH masses of these objects were taken from the compilation of Koss et al. (2022).

recipe.goal: Image ALMA 1 mm continuum and measure nuclear 1 mm luminosities
recipe.method: Combine continuum SPWs and line-free channels of line SPWs in CASA tclean (MFS mode), measure continuum flux density from the innermost synthesised beam coincident with the galaxy core, and compute L_nu,mm = 4 * pi * D_L^2 * f_mm * nu_obs.
assumptions: Extended dust emission is resolved out by long-baseline configurations and central point-like emission arises from the unresolved AGN core

recipe.goal: Compile X-ray luminosities and SMBH masses for primary and BASS samples
recipe.method: Retrieve intrinsic 2-10 keV X-ray luminosities and dynamical SMBH masses from literature; for galaxies without dynamical masses, estimate M_BH from stellar velocity dispersion using the M_BH-sigma_* relation of van den Bosch (2016), and recalibrate BASS M_BH-sigma_* masses to van den Bosch (2016).
assumptions: M_BH-sigma_* relation of van den Bosch (2016) applies to non-dynamical mass targets

recipe.goal: Fit 1D M_BH-L_nu,mm relation and 2D mm Fundamental Plane (M_BH-L_X,2-10-L_nu,mm)
recipe.method: Perform robust linear and plane regressions using lts_linefit and lts_planefit, and quantify statistical significance via Spearman rank correlation analyses.

recipe.goal: Compare observed correlations with theoretical SED models (Torus, ADAF, Compact Jet)
recipe.method: Extract predicted 237.5 GHz and 2-10 keV luminosities from grids of extrapolated SKIRTOR torus models, Pesce et al. (2021) LLAGN ADAF models, and Lucchini et al. (2022) Bhjet compact jet models, and compare with observations in luminosity and mmFP spaces.
key_parameters: ADAF grid: M_BH = 10^6 - 10^10 M_sun, Eddington ratios = 10^-7 - 10^-2, plus 0.5 dex M_BH offset
Bhjet grid: M_BH = 10^6 - 10^10 M_sun, jet power = 10^-5.5 - 10^-0.5 L_Edd, inclination = 2.5 deg - 90 deg
assumptions: Grey-body curve for mm emission and power-law for X-rays when extrapolating SKIRTOR models

recipe.goal: Test for spurious correlation and biases from distance uncertainties
recipe.method: Run Monte Carlo simulations drawing uncorrelated M_BH and L from Gaussian distributions with distance errors, and re-fit correlations restricting to the 26/48 sources with accurate redshift-independent distances.
assumptions: M_BH scales as D and L scales as D^2

score_reason: All derived tabular quantities (D, M_BH, L_nu,mm, L_X,2-10, and ALMA project codes) for the 48 primary sample galaxies are published in Table A1, and the fitting software (lts_linefit, lts_planefit) and SED codes (SKIRTOR, LLAGN, Bhjet) are public. However, reproducing the ALMA continuum flux measurements from raw visibilities requires unstated per-dataset imaging and line-free channel parameters across 26 projects, and the exact treatment of the 5 upper limits in the regression is not specified.
rediscovery_reason: All ALMA project codes are listed, raw data are public in the ALMA archive, Table A1 provides the complete set of galaxy measurements for immediate re-fitting of the regression equations, and the main results are crisp numeric scaling relation parameters.
